observations: Photo 0: A white and black game console standing upright, PlayStation butterfly logo visible on the front panel, a white/black DualSense-style controller leaning against it, a coiled black cable (looks like HDMI) and a small plug-type cable beside it, console top shows a faint purple/blue glow (could be a power light or screen reflection).

Photo 1: Close side view of the same console showing the disc slot on the edge, confirming this is a disc-drive model, plus the same controller and cables lying next to it, some scuff/scratch marks visible on the glossy black center strip.
No disc, no game case, no box, no serial number plate, and no powered-on home screen are visible in either photo.
Only one controller is shown despite the plural wording in places; seller's text says 'controller' (singular), consistent with photos.

claims.claim: Sony PlayStation 5 console and controller available
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows PlayStation logo and a matching DualSense-style controller
No disc, game case, or FIFA branding visible in either photo
Only a power cable and what looks like an HDMI cable are shown; no listed accessories (e.g., charging dock, extra controller) are pictured

risks.risk: Console may not power on or boot to home screen
risks.proof: A video clip showing the console powering on to the PS5 home menu

risks.risk: No FIFA disc or other game actually included
risks.proof: A photo of the FIFA disc and case next to the console with the console serial number visible
risks.if_unproven: priced as console-and-controller only, no game

risks.risk: Could be a Digital Edition mistaken for Disc Edition, or vice versa, affecting resale value
risks.proof: A clear photo of the disc slot area confirming drive presence
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lower-value variant seen (disc slot appears present, so priced as disc edition)

risks.risk: Cosmetic wear or internal damage not visible (e.g., fan noise, overheating, HDMI port damage)
risks.proof: A short video showing the console running and ports being tested
risks.if_unproven: priced as used with unknown internal condition

risks.risk: Could be a grey-market or modified/hacked unit (common in local listings) affecting legitimacy
risks.proof: Photo of the box, receipt, or serial number sticker matching a genuine Sony unit
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified origin, no premium for 'UK used' or similar claims

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and loading the PS5 home screen
Photo of the FIFA disc and any other included accessories laid out next to the console
Photo of the serial number / rear ports area and the original box if available
response.reason: The photos clearly show a genuine-looking PlayStation 5 disc-edition console with one controller, so it can be identified and priced at worst case (unproven power-on, no confirmed game disc or extra accessories).
